a single power-law A^n with a polynomial time factor each left NMSE around 1e-3 or worse.

The last candidate was a + b/t + c·ln t + d·√t + e·e^(−t) + f·t + g·t² + A²·(h + k·t^p), with p fitted to about 0.38. The A² amplitude looks like a power of t, but the additive time part is probably not right.
